reasoning_level.description: How much effort the harness spends reasoning about the given editing task. Higher reasoning effort means slower generation time. high plans the edit with segmentation, web search and reference photos, keeps unedited areas of a single input image, corrects required text, and bills a flat $0.125 (5 megapixels) more per request. low and medium bill $0.025 per megapixel of the output plus each reference (references larger than the output count as the output size). ultra generates at 2K with Krea's ultra thinking mode, ignores image_size and negative_prompt, and bills a flat price by reference count: $0.27 for 1, $0.30 for 2, $0.32 for 3, $0.35 for 4, plus $0.0275 per reference past 4.
reasoning_level.title: Reasoning Level
